title: Squish Button
summary: The button squashes under the press and springs back on release.
description: An overshooting release curve plus a horizontal squash on :active mimics a soft physical key.
accessibility_notes: Use a real <button>; keep a visible :focus-visible ring and never rely on hover alone to convey state. Motion stops under prefers-reduced-motion.
variations: Deeper squash for a rubber feel
Add a shadow that flattens on press
ai_usage: Mobile and playful UIs. The trick is asymmetric timing: instant on :active (transition-duration ~0s) and springy on release (cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1)) — equal timings feel mushy.
source:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
  <title>Squish Button</title>
  <script type="application/json" id="effect-meta">
  {
    "id": "squish-button",
    "title": "Squish Button",
    "summary": "The button squashes under the press and springs back on release.",
    "description": "An overshooting release curve plus a horizontal squash on :active mimics a soft physical key.",
    "theme": "buttons",
    "categories": ["button", "press"],
    "tags": ["squish", "press", "spring", "tactile", "active"],
    "tech": ["css"],
    "era": "2020s",
    "difficulty": "beginner",
    "dependencies": [],
    "browser_support": "All modern browsers (Chromium, Firefox, Safari).",
    "performance_notes": "Lightweight — composited transform/opacity work only.",
    "accessibility_notes": "Use a real <button>; keep a visible :focus-visible ring and never rely on hover alone to convey state. Motion stops under prefers-reduced-motion.",
    "customization": [
      { "name": "--c", "description": "Button color", "default": "#f472b6" },
      { "name": "--dur", "description": "Release spring", "default": "0.4s" }
    ],
    "variations": ["Deeper squash for a rubber feel", "Add a shadow that flattens on press", "Pair with haptics on touch"],
    "ai_usage": "Mobile and playful UIs. The trick is asymmetric timing: instant on :active (transition-duration ~0s) and springy on release (cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1)) — equal timings feel mushy."
  }
  </script>
  <style>
    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
    html, body { height: 100%; margin: 0; }
    body { display: grid; place-items: center; background: #0b0d12; color: #e7ebf3;
      font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif; overflow: hidden; }
    button { font: inherit; cursor: pointer; border: 0; }
    button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7c5cff; outline-offset: 3px; }
    :root { --c: #f472b6; --dur: .4s; }
    .squish { padding: 1rem 2.4rem; border-radius: 16px; background: var(--c); color: #23102a; font-weight: 800;
      box-shadow: 0 8px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--c) 55%, #000); transition: transform var(--dur) cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1), box-shadow var(--dur); }
    .squish:active { transform: translateY(6px) scale(1.06, .9); box-shadow: 0 2px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--c) 55%, #000); transition-duration: .05s; }
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      * { animation: none !important; transition: none !important; }
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <button class="squish" type="button">Press me</button>
</body>
</html>
